subsystems.name: Official test seams (TestSupport, NonInteractiveMode, mocks)
subsystems.summary: Static switches and injection points the game's own test suite uses to run the rules headless: TestMode.IsOn (static flag), NonInteractiveMode.IsActive (TestMode or AutoSlay), ICardSelector stacks inside CardSelectCmd, TestRngInjector one-shot overrides for the four high-entropy draws, RunRngSet.MockRng per-stream replacement, RunState.CreateForTest (Deprived test character, UnlockState.all), ModelDb.Init(injectedTypes)/Inject/Remove/ResetForTest, SaveManager mock instance, RewardsSet.testSelector, RestSiteOption.generateForTests and per-model test overrides.
rules_dependent: ~39 content files branch on TestMode; almost all only skip VFX/SFX/Godot nodes
TestMode branches that change rule outcomes or RNG consumption are listed in test_seams.testmode_divergences and must take the TestMode.IsOff branch in the sim
subsystems.justification: The seams themselves are test infrastructure, not rules. The sim needs equivalents (decision API in place of ICardSelector, explicit RNG state in place of TestRngInjector, populateMonsters-style factories in place of CreateForTest) but must follow the shipping (TestMode.IsOff) rule paths. Mock models (48 files under Models.*.Mocks and Models.Orbs.Mock plus Deprived/MockCardPool/MockPotionPool) are excluded from the registry.
sim_notes: Treat NonInteractiveMode.IsActive == true for waits/pauses (Cmd.Wait no-ops, ActionExecutor awaits each action to completion) but TestMode.IsOn == false for every rule branch

MockPotionPool is registered in ModelDb.AllSharedPotionPools (Models/ModelDb.cs:187-194); exclude it from any sim pool list (rules only read character + SharedPotionPool, Factories/PotionFactory.cs:65)

subsystems.name: Player-choice prompts (CardSelectCmd, selector stack, CardSelectorPrefs, PlayerChoiceContext)
subsystems.summary: All in-combat and deck card prompts go through 13 CardSelectCmd entry points. Each first applies auto-resolution (0 options -> empty; count <= MinSelect && !RequireManualConfirmation -> all), then asks Selector (global stack), else LocalSelector, else the Godot screen. A selector answer is synchronous and skips ReserveChoiceId/SignalPlayerChoiceBegun. CardReward.OnSelect consults Selector.GetSelectedCardReward. Content can push its own selector (WhisperingEarring pushes VakuuCardSelector = take first maxSelect options). FromChooseABundleScreen has no selector seam (TestMode -> bundles[0]). RelicSelectCmd.FromChooseARelicScreen has no callers in v0.111.0.
rules_dependent: 107 content files call CardSelectCmd (42 cards, 5 powers, 29 relics, 9 potions, 1 monster, 20 events, 1 modifier)
card rewards (Rewards/CardReward.cs:590-700) and reward alternatives (Skip/Reroll/hook-added, max 2)
subsystems.justification: Every prompt is a decision point of the environment (P1 plan: each player-choice prompt is a search node). The auto-resolution rules decide whether a decision point exists at all, so they must be ported exactly.
sim_notes: Model a selector stack in CombatState/RunState: the agent is the bottom selector; content-pushed selectors (VakuuCardSelector) resolve prompts without a decision

Prompts can open inside HookPlayerChoiceContext dispatchers (AfterDeath, AfterDiedToDoom, AfterSideTurnEnd, BeforeFlush, BeforeSideTurnEnd, BeforeSideTurnStart; CombatManager end-turn phases and StartTurn); monster code passes ThrowingPlayerChoiceContext to many of its own commands (a prompt there would throw; 173 content files reference it), but monster attacks fall back to BlockingPlayerChoiceContext (Commands.Builders/AttackCommand.cs:423, :434, :1132, :1146), so a player listener reacting to an enemy attack can open a prompt during the enemy turn
Draw-pile prompts sort options by (Rarity, Id) on the selector path (Commands/CardSelectCmd.cs:3403-3405)

subsystems.name: Enchantments (card-attached modifiers, persistent on deck cards)
subsystems.summary: 22 concrete enchantments (+DeprecatedEnchantment, +1 mock). One per card (stackable only with the same type), stored on the deck card and copied into combat. Integrates via EnchantDamageAdditive/Multiplicative (Hook.ModifyDamage), EnchantBlockAdditive/Multiplicative (Hook.ModifyBlock), EnchantPlayCount (CardModel replay count), OnPlay (after card effect), OnEnchant (keyword/cost changes), and ordinary hooks while ShouldReceiveCombatHooks (card is a listener). ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile is applied at combat start.
rules_dependent: hook listener order: card, then its affliction, then its enchantment (Combat/CombatState.cs:903-910)
subsystems.justification: Applied in standard runs by 16 relics, 9 events and the card BladeOfInk; they change damage, block, play count, costs and keywords.
sim_notes: Goopy increments both the combat copy and Card.DeckVersion.Enchantment.Amount: the deck/combat card link must exist in the sim
Slither re-rolls cost with Rng.CombatEnergyCosts.NextInt(4) on draw
Status = Disabled is per combat copy (Glam/Sown/Swift/Vigorous)
CanEnchant base rule: not Status/Curse/Quest, not Unplayable deck cards, at most one enchantment unless IsStackable and same type (Models/EnchantmentModel.cs:294-315)

subsystems.name: Afflictions (monster-applied card debuffs)
subsystems.summary: 7 afflictions (Bound, Entangled, Galvanized, Hexed, Ringing, Smog, Tainted) applied to cards in combat by 7 monster powers (ChainsOfBinding, Galvanic, Hex, Ringing, Smoggy, Tangled, VitalSpark) from 7 encounters. Most behaviour lives in the applying power; afflictions are hook listeners (ShouldReceiveCombatHooks true) and record CardAfflictedEntry in combat history.
rules_dependent: random target pick AfflictionModel.PickRandomTargets with Rng.CombatCardGeneration
subsystems.justification: Part of act 2/3 monster content (CeremonialBeastBoss, GlobeHeadNormal, InfestedPrismsElite, KnightsElite, LivingFogNormal, QueenBoss, VineShamblerNormal).
sim_notes: PickRandomTargets keeps the first min(count, n) shuffled cards via RemoveRange(Clamp(n-1, 0, count), Max(0, n-count)) (Models/AfflictionModel.cs:245-250)
Cleared by the applying powers on removal and by NightmarePower

subsystems.name: Run modifiers (custom and daily runs)
subsystems.summary: 16 modifiers (+DeprecatedModifier). ModelDb.GoodModifiers = Draft, SealedDeck, Hoarder, Specialized, Insanity, AllStar, Flight, Vintage, CharacterCards; BadModifiers = DeadlyEvents, CursedRun, BigGameHunter, Midas, Murderous, NightTerrors, Terminal; SealedDeck/Draft/Insanity mutually exclusive. Modifiers are run-level hook listeners (after cards in the combat listener order) plus OnRunCreated/OnRunLoaded and GenerateNeowOption.
subsystems.justification: A standard run is started with System.Array.Empty<ModifierModel>() and GameMode.Standard (Nodes.Screens.CharacterSelect/NCharacterSelectScreen.cs:966; BeginRun logs an error and ignores non-empty modifiers, :1794-1799). Only Custom and Daily runs carry modifiers, and no content adds a modifier mid-run.
sim_notes: Keep RunState.Modifiers as an always-empty list so the Neow Count<=0 branches take the standard path
The 12 cards with CanBeGeneratedByModifiers => false only matter to modifier generators

subsystems.name: Daily runs
subsystems.summary: Daily seed/character/modifiers are derived in UI code from the server date (Nodes.Screens.DailyRun/NDailyRunScreen.cs:917-922: Rng(GetDeterministicHashCode('dd_MM_yyyy')) then three child Rngs). TimeServer fetches network time. DailyRunUtility only uploads scores and names leaderboards.
subsystems.justification: Not part of standard single-player runs; seed derivation is UI-side and network-time dependent.

subsystems.name: GameMode (None/Standard/Daily/Custom)
subsystems.summary: Enum stored on RunState. In rule code it only gates RunManager.ShouldApplyTutorialModifications (Standard => apply discovery-order modifications, unless TestMode). AreAchievementsAndEpochsLocked (non-Standard) only affects progress/achievements.
rules_dependent: ActModel.ApplyDiscoveryOrderModifications (boss discovery order, first-run room order)
subsystems.justification: Constant GameMode.Standard for the sim, but its single rule effect (discovery-order modifications) must be ported because it is ON in every standard run.
sim_notes: ShouldApplyTutorialModifications returns false under TestMode: the sim must follow the TestMode.IsOff branch

subsystems.name: Badges (end-of-run score badges)
subsystems.summary: 23 Badge classes evaluated on the finished SerializableRun for score (Models.Badges/BadgePool.cs; Runs/ScoreUtility.cs:127). Two BadgeModel hook listeners (CccComboModel counts cards played per turn, DebufferModel counts debuffs applied) write only Player.ExtraFields.CccomboBadgeUnlocked / DebuffsApplied, which only badges read.
subsystems.justification: No rule reads badge state; BadgeModel listeners return CompletedTask and touch only ExtraFields that are read exclusively by Badge.IsObtained.
sim_notes: Excluding them does not shift any other listener (they come after modifiers in the listener list)

subsystems.name: Orbs (Defect)
subsystems.summary: 5 orbs (Lightning 3/8 dmg to random enemy via Rng.CombatTargets; Frost 2/5 block; Dark passive +6 to its evoke (start 6), evoke hits the weakest hittable enemy; Plasma 1 energy at turn start / 2 on evoke; Glass passive 4 decreasing by 1, evoke = 2x passive to all enemies). OrbQueue: capacity (max 10), Channel = add 1 slot for a character with BaseOrbSlotCount 0 and capacity 0, evoke front when full, enqueue, history OrbChanneled, Hook.AfterOrbChanneled. EvokeNext = first orb, EvokeLast = last orb. Lightning/Frost/Glass values and Dark's passive pass through Hook.ModifyOrbValue; Dark's accumulated evoke value and Plasma's values do not. Orbs are hook listeners placed after potions and before cards.
rules_dependent: turn hooks: OrbQueue.BeforeTurnEnd (Combat/CombatManager.cs:1198), OrbQueue.AfterTurnStart under HookPlayerChoiceContext (Combat/CombatManager.cs:5119)
PlayerCombatState: new OrbQueue with capacity Player.BaseOrbSlotCount each combat (Entities.Players/PlayerCombatState.cs:274-276)
random orb: OrbModel.GetRandomOrb(Rng.CombatOrbGeneration) over 5 ids incl. GlassOrb (Chaos, TrashToTreasurePower)
subsystems.justification: Core Defect mechanic; 43 content files call OrbCmd (30 cards, 6 powers, 5 relics, 2 potions) and any character can channel (slot auto-added).
sim_notes: ModelDb.Orbs lists 4 orbs (no Glass) but GetRandomOrb draws from 5
Orb state (DarkOrb _evokeVal, GlassOrb _passiveVal) is per-instance mutable and must be cloned/hashed
RemoveCapacity evicts from the back (Entities.Orbs/OrbQueue.cs:419-427)

subsystems.name: Osty and pets (Necrobinder summon)
subsystems.summary: Osty is a MonsterModel pet (1 HP, single NOTHING_MOVE) owned by the player (PetOwner). OstyCmd.Summon: amount = Hook.ModifySummonAmount; if Osty alive -> GainMaxHp(amount); else revive (AddPetInternal) or create (PlayerCmd.AddPet<Osty> + DieForYouPower 1), then SetMaxHp(amount), Heal(amount), Hook.AfterOstyRevived on revive; then History.Summoned and Hook.AfterSummon. DieForYouPower redirects powered attacks aimed at the owner to Osty (ModifyUnblockedDamageTarget); overkill flows back to the owner (HpLossHookPhase.BeforeOsty/AfterOsty in CreatureCmd damage). Osty is killed when the player dies.
rules_dependent: history CreatureAttacked with Actor == Owner.Osty (Flatten, Rattle)
pets are allies but not PlayerCreatures (AnyAlly targeting still sees no living ally in single player)
subsystems.justification: Core Necrobinder mechanic; OstyCmd used by 15 files, Osty referenced by 24; other pets are spawned by 7 monsters and 4 relics (Byrdpip, PaelsLegion, BoundPhylactery, PhylacteryUnbound).
sim_notes: Pets live in PlayerCombatState.Pets and in CombatState allies; PlayerCombatState.AfterCombatEnd clears pets
Summoned history entries are write-only (no reader)

subsystems.name: Stars (Regent resource)
subsystems.summary: Integer per-combat resource (starts at 0 in each new PlayerCombatState). Setter records History.StarsModified(delta). Cards carry CanonicalStarCost (-1 = none), BaseStarCost, TemporaryStarCost, HasStarCostX and LastStarsSpent; Hook.ModifyStarCost adjusts. HasEnoughResourcesFor: if energy cost exceeds energy and Hook.ShouldPayExcessEnergyCostWithStars, each missing energy costs 2 stars. GainStars is gated by Hook.ShouldGainStars and followed by Hook.AfterStarsGained; spending fires Hook.AfterStarsSpent. Lose/Gain clamp at 0.
rules_dependent: history StarsModified (Radiate sums positive deltas this turn)
subsystems.justification: 44 content files (32 cards, 4 powers, 7 relics, 1 potion); the sim's PlayerState already has a Stars field.
sim_notes: PlayerCmd.LoseStars is a no-op once the combat is ending (Commands/PlayerCmd.cs:857-866)

subsystems.name: Forge (Regent Sovereign Blade)
subsystems.summary: ForgeCmd.Forge(amount): no-op if combat over/ending; if the player has no non-dupe SovereignBlade outside the exhaust pile, create one (CreatedThroughForge = true) and add it to hand via AddGeneratedCardToCombat; then every non-dupe SovereignBlade including exhausted ones gets AddDamage(amount) and AfterForged; then Hook.AfterForge.
rules_dependent: SovereignBlade damage var and CreatedThroughForge reset (Models.Cards/SovereignBlade.cs:263-359)
subsystems.justification: 15 files call ForgeCmd.Forge (11 cards, 2 powers, 1 relic, 1 potion); 19 reference SovereignBlade.
sim_notes: The VFX/preview half (PreviewSovereignBlade, PlayCombatRoomForgeVfx) has no rule effect

subsystems.name: Ancient events and dialogue
namespaces: Models.Events (Neow, Darv, Orobas, Pael, Tezcatara, Nonupeipe, Tanx, Vakuu, TheArchitect)
subsystems.summary: AncientEventModel subclasses: Neow (acts Overgrowth/Underdocks), Orobas/Pael/Tezcatara (Hive), Nonupeipe/Tanx/Vakuu (Glory), Darv (shared). On enter: heal missing HP (x0.8 at WearyTraveler); Neow first sets HP to 0, so Neow heals to MaxHp (x0.8). Options come from GenerateInitialOptions unless Hook.ShouldAllowAncient blocks (then a single PROCEED). Dialogue (Entities.Ancients) is picked in UI code with Rng.Chaotic from profile visit counts and has no rule effect. TheArchitect is a separate EventModel entered after the last act (victory); its dialogue/VFX consume the event Rng but nothing follows.
rules_dependent: ancient selection per act: ActModel.GenerateRooms picks _rooms.Ancient from GetUnlockedAncients + shared subset (Models/ActModel.cs:322)
shared ancient subset distribution with Rng.UpFront (Runs/RunManager.cs:4055-4072)
subsystems.justification: Ancients are on every act's map (MapPointType.Ancient) and grant relics/upgrades; dialogue and TheArchitect are excluded (no rule effect / post-victory terminal state).
sim_notes: Treat entering TheArchitect event as run victory (terminal)
DebugOption replaces the first option only in debug (Models/AncientEventModel.cs:280-284)

subsystems.name: Unlock state and timeline epochs
subsystems.summary: UnlockState = {revealed epoch ids, encounters seen, NumberOfRuns}, snapshotted per player at run creation from the profile (SaveManager.GenerateUnlockStateFromProgress) and stored in SerializablePlayer.UnlockState; RunState.UnlockState merges players (union of sets, max runs). UnlockState.all = every epoch, every encounter, NumberOfRuns 999999999; FromSerializable(null) = all. 57 epochs: 48 gate concrete content (3 cards/relics/potions each per character tier, 5 colorless card tiers, 2 potion tiers, 5 relic tiers, 3 event epochs, 4 character epochs), plus NeowEpoch, UnderdocksEpoch, DarvEpoch, OrobasEpoch (rule gates without lists) and Act2B/Act3B/CustomAndSeeds/DailyRun (no rule gate in v0.111.0). See unlock_profile_dependence for every rule path.
rules_dependent: ancients per act and shared ancient Darv
character set (Orobas, Kaleidoscope, Splash, PrismaticGem, ColorfulPhilosophers)
subsystems.justification: Unlock state changes which content can appear and therefore RNG outcomes; it is a run input (in the save), not UI. Timeline UI, epoch reveal flow and stories are excluded.
sim_notes: Default: UnlockState.all semantics plus 'all acts discovered' (DiscoveredActs is a live profile read outside UnlockState)
Replay of a recorded run: load each SerializablePlayer.UnlockState from the save

subsystems.name: Multiplayer scaling and player-count branches
subsystems.summary: MultiplayerScalingModel is a combat hook listener whose only override (ModifyBlockMultiplicative on enemies) returns Players.Count when <= 2, i.e. 1m in single player, and 1m multipliers are not recorded as modifiers. Monster HP scaling and power-amount scaling are skipped when playerCount <= 1. Single-player is not a pure no-op: IRunState.CardMultiplayerConstraint = SingleplayerOnly removes the 37 MultiplayerOnly cards from every pool via CardPoolModel.GetUnlockedCards; ActModel.GetNumberOfRooms subtracts 1 room only in multiplayer; AnyAlly-target cards are unplayable in single player (NoLivingAllies: PlayerCreatures excludes pets).
subsystems.justification: Single-player identity confirmed by code; keep the SingleplayerOnly pool filter and the Count<=1 branch of every player-count check (33 rule files contain such checks).
sim_notes: Do not register MultiplayerScalingModel as a listener; it cannot change any value at Players.Count == 1

subsystems.name: Combat history
subsystems.summary: Append-only per-combat log owned by CombatManager (cleared at combat end/reset). 17 entry types; each entry stores Actor, RoundNumber, CurrentSide and a snapshot of every player's TurnNumber. Content reads it through 45 query sites in 45 files (29 cards, 12 powers, 4 relics); 3 entry types are write-only. See combat_history section for every query.
rules_dependent: cost reductions on cards entering combat
subsystems.justification: Queries change damage, costs, playability and triggers; generated cards compute their state from history on entering combat, so counters alone are fragile.
sim_notes: Store an immutable-entry log with structural sharing (clone = share prefix + length) and port each query as written
HappenedThisTurn requires equal RoundNumber, CurrentSide and every player's TurnNumber; HappenedLastPlayerTurn compares only the given player's TurnNumber - 1

subsystems.name: Card entity helpers (Entities.Cards)
subsystems.summary: 38 files. Rule-bearing: CardPile (list order, MaxCardsInHand 10, top = index 0, RandomizeOrderInternal = UnstableShuffle + TestRngInjector override + Hook.ModifyShuffleOrder(isInitialShuffle: true)), CardPlay (Player, Target, Resources, PlayIndex/IsFirstInSeries, IsAutoPlay), CardEnergyCost + LocalCostModifier (Absolute/Relative, reduce-only, expiration EndOfCombat=0/EndOfTurn=2/WhenPlayed=4) + TemporaryCardCost/Offset (UntilPlayed/ThisTurn/ThisCombat), CardTransformation (fixed replacement, option list or CardFactory random with transform rng), CardCreationResult (modified-by-relic wrapper for rewards), ResourceInfo, CardLocation (player, pile, position), CardPileAddResult, enums (CardKeyword, CardType, CardRarity, CardTag, PileType, TargetType, UnplayableReason flags, AutoPlayType, CostModifiers/KeywordSources flags, CardScope, OrbEvokeType, CardMultiplayerConstraint), extensions (IsSingleTarget, IsCombatPile, GetNextHighestRarityWithWrapping, HasResourceCostReason). UI-only: CardPreviewMode, CardCostColor, CardKeywordOrder, CardUpgradePreviewType, CardKeywordExtensions loc helpers, PileTypeExtensions.GetTargetPosition.
rules_dependent: every card play and pile move
subsystems.justification: Mostly already partially ported in P0 (CardPile, CardEnergyCost, CardPlay, enums); the remainder is required by the content kernel.
sim_notes: CardPrefs.RequireManualConfirmation = MinSelect >= 0 && MinSelect != MaxSelect decides auto-resolution of prompts
PileType.Deck is the run deck; IsCombatPile = Draw..Play

subsystems.name: Helpers and extensions with rule semantics
subsystems.summary: Rule-bearing: AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension/HasAscension (reads RunManager.Instance; 102 monster files), ListExtensions.UnstableShuffle (Fisher-Yates from the end, NextInt(i+1)), StableShuffle (List.Sort with IComparable then UnstableShuffle), IEnumerableExtensions.TakeRandom (shuffle a full copy then Take), GrabBag (weighted roulette with rejection resampling; ActModel encounters), StringHelper (Slugify, SnakeCase, GetDeterministicHashCode XXH64, GetDeterministicHashCodeOld), SeedHelper (CanonicalizeSeed; GetRandomSeed with BadWordChecker rejection), EggRelicHelper (upgrade reward cards of one type), Really.bigNumber 999999999, TaskHelper.RunSafely (fire-and-forget tasks inside rule code), NonInteractiveMode, OneTimeInitialization (ModelDb.Init order). UI-only: CardCostHelper, Ease, EnergyIconHelper, GlyphConverter, GodotTreeExtensions, HandLayoutHelper, HandPosHelper, ImageHelper, MathHelper, SceneHelper, ScrollHelper, SpineNodeExtensions, StsColors, TimeFormatting, DisplayVars, CommandLineHelper, ReflectionHelper (type discovery, mods), SignalAwaiterExtensions.
subsystems.justification: The shuffles and hashing are already ported in P0 (RngCollectionExtensions, DeterministicHash); AscensionHelper maps to cs.GetValueIfAscension; GrabBag and EggRelicHelper are needed by the run layer and relics.
sim_notes: StableShuffle depends on .NET List.Sort (introsort, unstable for equal keys): keep List<T>.Sort with the game's comparer (CardModel: ModelId ordinal, then upgrade level), never OrderBy
TakeRandom consumes Count-1 draws regardless of count
Rng.NextItem consumes one NextInt even for a single item and nothing for an empty sequence (Random/Rng.cs:213-223)

subsystems.name: Localization.DynamicVars (numeric card/power/relic variables)
subsystems.summary: 24 DynamicVar types + DynamicVarSet. BaseValue clamps to 999999999; EnchantedValue/PreviewValue are display values. Rule-bearing types: DamageVar/BlockVar (value + ValueProp), CalculatedVar/CalculatedDamageVar/CalculatedBlockVar (CalculationBase.BaseValue + CalculationExtra.BaseValue x static multiplier(card, target); multiplier is 0 unless CombatManager.IsInProgress and card in combat; FromOsty), CalculationBaseVar, CalculationExtraVar, ExtraDamageVar, OstyDamageVar, PowerVar<T> (power amount), SummonVar, CardsVar, EnergyVar, StarsVar, ForgeVar, GoldVar, HealVar, HpLossVar, MaxHpVar, RepeatVar, IntVar, BoolVar (0/1), IfUpgradedVar (display enum), StringVar (text). DynamicVarSet exposes named accessors (Damage, Block, Cards, Energy, Strength, Vulnerable, Weak, Poison, Doom, Dexterity, Stars, Summon, Forge, Gold, Heal, HpLoss, MaxHp, Repeat, OstyDamage, ExtraDamage, CalculatedDamage, CalculatedBlock, CalculationBase, CalculationExtra) and RecalculateForUpgradeOrEnchant/FinalizeUpgrade.
subsystems.justification: Content constants and upgrade deltas live here; the P0 sim has DynamicVar/DynamicVarSet with Damage/Block only.
sim_notes: Content construction counts in Models.*: DamageVar 210, PowerVar 194, DynamicVar 182, CardsVar 171, BlockVar 105, EnergyVar 86, StringVar 65, CalculationBaseVar 43, GoldVar 31, RepeatVar 30, HealVar 24, CalculationExtraVar 24, MaxHpVar 21, ExtraDamageVar 19, CalculatedDamageVar 19, HpLossVar 18, StarsVar 17, CalculatedVar 17, SummonVar 15, ForgeVar 13, IntVar 12, OstyDamageVar 11, CalculatedBlockVar 7 (raw construction-site counts, async duplicates included)
UpdateCardPreview paths are display-only; actual damage goes through Hook.ModifyDamage with the enchantment applied there

subsystems.name: Saves: profile/progress state read by rules
subsystems.summary: ProgressState holds epochs, character/card/encounter/enemy/ancient stats, discovered cards/relics/potions/events/acts, WongoPoints, TestSubjectKills, ArchitectDamage, UniqueId, FTUE flags. Rules read the profile in two ways: (1) through the run's UnlockState snapshot (preferred, saved), (2) live through SaveManager.Instance.Progress in 5 paths (act discovery, first-run tutorial room, WelcomeToWongos points, single-player ascension clamp in the lobby, TheArchitect dialogue after victory) plus display-only reads (Vakuu visits, TestSubject title, LoomingFruit icon, MaxAscensionWhenRunStarted, ancient dialogue). PrefsSave.FastMode only changes VFX timing.
subsystems.justification: Only a handful of profile facts matter; expose them as explicit run parameters with all-unlocked defaults instead of porting the save system. Save import (read path) belongs to the run-layer study.
sim_notes: Profile facts parameter: {UnlockState per player, DiscoveredActs, ProfileNumberOfRuns, WongoPoints}

subsystems.name: ModelDb registry, ids, pools and lookups
subsystems.summary: Static registry keyed by ModelId(Category, Entry): Category = Slugify(name of the first subclass under AbstractModel) minus '_MODEL' (CARD, POWER, RELIC, ...), Entry = Slugify(class name). Init instantiates every type in AbstractModelSubtypes.All plus mod subtypes; canonical instances are shared, ToMutable clones. Pools: 5 characters (Ironclad, Silent, Regent, Necrobinder, Defect); shared card pools Colorless, Curse, Deprecated, Event, Quest, Status, Token; shared relic pools Deprecated, Event, Fallback, Shared; shared potion pools Deprecated, Event, Mock, Shared, Token. Pool order = GenerateAllCards/Relics/Potions array order (+ mods); epoch filters use RemoveAll (order preserved). Acts: Overgrowth(0, default), Underdocks(0), Hive(1), Glory(2). AllRelics/AllPotions are sorted by Id.Entry with the default culture-sensitive comparer; ModelId.CompareTo is ordinal. ModelDb has no randomized lookup itself; content draws through CardFactory (GetDistinctForCombat = player-count filter + FilterForCombat + TakeRandom; GetForCombat = NextItem with replacement; CreateForReward = rarity roll then NextItem on PlayerRng.Rewards; CreateRandomCardForTransform), PotionFactory (character + Shared unlocked potions, rarity then NextItem), RelicFactory (grab-bag pulls, RollRarity 0.5/0.83, fallback Circlet) and OrbModel.GetRandomOrb.
rules_dependent: every random pick from a pool depends on pool order
ids appear in saves and recordings
subsystems.justification: The sim registry (Registry/Registries.cs) already mirrors the id rule; pools must reproduce the game's array order exactly.
sim_notes: Per-model inventories are in sibling files sim/specs/inventory/{cards,powers,relics,potions,...}.json and pools.json
Never iterate HashSet/Dictionary keyed by ModelId or string for ordered choices (string hashes are randomized per process)

subsystems.name: LocalContext (local-player identity)
subsystems.summary: Static NetId of the local player. IsMe(player) is true for the single-player player (netId 1); IsMe(creature) is false for monsters and pets without Player; IsMine(card) requires a mutable card owned by the local player. 27 content files gate on it; rule-relevant cases include MembershipCard price discount (ModifyMerchantPrice requires IsMe(Owner)), ThievingHopper target fallback, SoulFysh Beckon handling, Vakuu/TheArchitect display.
subsystems.justification: Single player: IsMe(player) == true, IsMe(non-player creature) == false; no state needed.

subsystems.name: Achievements, stories, epoch reveal UI, stats
subsystems.summary: Progress bookkeeping after combats/runs (UpdateProgressAfterCombatWon, UpdateProgressWithRunData, MarkCardAsSeen/MarkRelicAsSeen), achievements and Steam stats, metrics upload.
subsystems.justification: Writes only; no rule reads them during a run except through the UnlockState snapshot taken at run start.

switches.name: TestMode.IsOn
switches.effect: static flag; set by TurnOnInternal (:45-48); IsTestRunFromCmdline checks for RiderTestRunner/ in Godot OS.GetCmdlineArgs (:22-25)

switches.name: NonInteractiveMode.IsActive
switches.effect: TestMode.IsOn || AutoSlayerCheck(); AutoSlayer installs AutoSlayerCheck = () => IsActive in its static ctor (AutoSlay/AutoSlayer.cs:2529-2532)

injection_points.name: ICardSelector / CardSelectCmd selector stacks
injection_points.effect: UseSelector (only if empty) / PushSelector / SuspendSelectorForTest; global and local-only stacks; Selector answers every CardSelectCmd prompt except FromChooseABundleScreen, plus CardReward.GetSelectedCardReward

injection_points.name: TestCardSelector
injection_points.effect: queued answers by card or by index (selected cards must be among options, else throws); no queued answer -> empty selection; default card reward = first option; PrepareToBlock makes the next prompt block (pause/resume tests)

injection_points.name: TestRngInjector

execution_order_facts.fact: NonInteractiveMode: each dequeued GameAction is awaited to completion before the next one is dequeued; interactive mode may continue with other ready actions while an action is paused for a player choice (:151-161)
after every executed action except EndPlayerTurnAction and ReadyToBeginEnemyTurnAction, CombatManager.CheckWinCondition() runs while the combat is in progress
NonInteractiveMode throws if an action finishes in a non-Executing state: no action may be left paused, i.e. every choice must resolve synchronously
Cmd.Wait / CustomScaledWait are skipped in NonInteractiveMode (and in FastMode Instant)
pausing is disabled under AutoSlay/NonInteractive; TestMode polls unpause with Task.Delay(50)
in TestMode nothing may subscribe to CombatStateChanged: rule code does not depend on UI state-change events
with a Selector installed no choice id is reserved and SignalPlayerChoiceBegun/Ended are not called; auto-resolution happens before the selector is consulted
GodotTimerTask uses Task.Delay in TestMode instead of a SceneTree timer (no rule effect)
